mentions.name: ble_proxy
mentions.description: A published tool that turns a cell phone into a network proxy using BLE, so a laptop can route traffic through a phone connected to a Wi-Fi network (hotel, plane, etc.). It is slow but useful when you only need a small amount of data.
mentions.problem: Built on a plane ride where the cellphone had data but the laptop didn't; covers cases where you just need a little bit of data to work.
mentions.source_excerpt: This turns your cell phone into a network proxy, but using BLE so the phone can be connected to a Wifi network (hotel, plane, etc). It's pretty slow, but in some cases you just need a little bit of data to work.

evidence.value: This turns your cell phone into a network proxy, but using BLE so the phone can be connected to a Wifi network (hotel, plane, etc). It's pretty slow, but in some cases you just need a little bit of data to work.
